items.title: PHP2Shell: Critical RCE vulnerabilities in PHP affecting Magento
items.summary: Two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.2) in the PHP engine affect Magento and other PHP platforms, allowing unauthenticated attackers to run code. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after the fixes were released on October 21, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including critical arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) and privilege escalation issues. Adobe reported no known exploits in the wild for these issues at the time of release.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | StyleSmuggler 0-day RCE
items.summary: An emergency hotfix was released for a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) known as StyleSmuggler, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. This vulnerability was actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including critical stored cross-site scripting flaws.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An unauthenticated unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows arbitrary code execution, with mass exploitation observed. Adobe shipped the fix as part of the August 2026 patch set (APSB26-73).

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution and customer account takeover. Although patched in August 2025, mass exploitation was observed in October 2026.
